results.title: Philippine economic growth slows further to 2.1% in Q3 2026
results.content: The latest GDP figure is even lower than the revised 2.4% growth recorded in Q2 2026, and also below the revised 4% posted in Q3 2025

results.title: Philippines’ West PH Sea, China discord seeps through fissures
results.content: ‘Transparency must support diplomacy rather than displace, constrain or collide with it,’ says the DFA, exposing what many observers and analysts have long pointed out — incongruence between the DFA and the country’s maritime frontline agencies
